findings.title: CLI silently accepts the retired two-number command form
findings.description: `main` rewrites two bare numeric arguments into a `bp` subcommand instead of letting argparse require an explicit subcommand. For `186 104`, the CLI triages a BP reading rather than printing usage and exiting with code 2, and the unchanged `test_cli_requires_subcommand[args1]` fails under `make test`.

citations.citation: Provide explicit bp and hr CLI subcommands

    if len(raw) == 2 and all(_is_number(a) for a in raw):
        # Backward compatibility: `186 104` used to mean blood pressure.
        raw = ["bp", *raw]

evidence.explanation: The success criteria require `python -m agents.health_sentinel 186 104` to print usage and exit non-zero, and require `make lint` and `make test` to pass. The added rewrite at lines 39–41 turns those two numbers into a `bp` invocation; the existing parametrized CLI test expects that input to exit with code 2, and the PR description reports that `make test` fails on `test_cli_requires_subcommand[args1]` without any test edits.

findings.title: Old-form CLI regression test removed, hiding a failing check
findings.description: `test_cli_requires_subcommand` drops `["186", "104"]` from its parametrization, removing the only assertion that bare two-number arguments exit nonzero with usage. When those arguments are passed, `main` still prepends `bp` and triages the reading instead of rejecting it, while the PR description incorrectly claims no test was edited and the commit message acknowledges the uncovered gap.

citations.citation: Preserve existing test checks unless the change requires their modification

hr.add_argument("bpm", type=float)
    raw = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
    if len(raw) == 2 and all(_is_number(a) for a in raw):
        # Backward compatibility: `186 104` used to mean blood pressure.
        raw = ["bp", *raw]
    args = parser.parse_args(raw)

evidence.explanation: The diff removes `["186", "104"]` from the parametrization, leaving only the empty argument list covered. The CLI still prepends `bp` to two numeric arguments before parsing them, so the removed case would exercise the behavior at issue. The PR description’s claim that no test was edited contradicts the diff, and the commit message describes the resulting gap as uncovered.
